summary: The ElevenLabs Free plan includes 10,000 shared credits per monthly billing cycle, approximately 10 minutes of text-to-speech at typical pricing. Other products draw from the same balance at their own rates. Free-plan credits do not roll over. Content generated on the Free plan can be used noncommercially with attribution; a commercial license is not included.
claim_steps: Create a free ElevenLabs account and select/keep the Free plan.
Check the Subscription page for the monthly credit reset date and balance; credits are shared across products and do not roll over on Free.
Generate content within the balance and applicable product/per-request limits.
Use free-plan outputs noncommercially with required attribution; review service-specific terms before publishing.

social_proof.title: Free-plan commercial-use restriction
social_proof.text: If you are on the free plan, you can use the content non-commercially with attribution.
